title: Choose the visual world for the ICSIFT home page
question: Re-roll 1 assigned Solar Array. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: Solar Array
options.lineage: photovoltaic panels on a mounting rail
options.thesis: The page is one solar panel: content lives in its cells, and the cells light up as the visitor takes the actions that matter.
options.viewport: A full-width panel of deep-indigo cells on a silver frame: the theme set across a block of cells, Submit (sunlit yellow) and Register as two cells top right, indexing and awards in the cells below.
options.risk: A literal sustainability symbol; it turns into stock clip art if the cell grid stops carrying the content.

raised.raise: Cells are fixed-ratio units that re-count per viewport and never stretch.
Confirmed facts sit in lit cells; to-be-announced facts (the full venue) sit in visibly unlit cells.
Text is set in courses whose measure matches the row of cells it occupies.

options.label: Goals Program
options.lineage: the UN Sustainable Development Goals identity
options.thesis: The conference set in the 17-colour SDG tile system its audience already reads daily.
options.viewport: A white headline cell for the 4th ICSIFT beside a wall of numbered goal tiles; Submit and Register under the title.
options.risk: Familiar: nearly every sustainability event borrows this system, and it overlaps the separate SDG figure.

options.label: Event Display
options.thesis: Every paper is a track curving out of one collision: the conference.
options.viewport: A ring cross-section centred on Bangkok, 21–22 Feb, tracks fanning out to the topics.
options.case: Researchers recognise the scientific form; loses on clarity because the offer hides inside the diagram.
options.risk: Reads physics-only and dark-tech for a sustainability audience.

options.label: Provenance Ribbon
options.thesis: One ribbon traces the editions from 2024 to 2027.
options.viewport: A red ribbon running through dated editions.
options.case: Fuses poorly: archive mood dampens a call to submit.
options.kept: Known and not-yet-known facts are visually distinct.

options.label: Gridsmith Showroom
options.viewport: A black-and-white lattice framing the conference title.
options.case: Fuses poorly: Viennese luxury has no tie to the audience.
options.kept: Square units that re-count, never stretch.

options.label: Coiled Earth Tower
options.thesis: The page rises in clay courses.
options.viewport: Banded clay courses carrying the title.
options.case: Fuses poorly: craft material, weak link to future technologies.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A conference landing page as the category ships it, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Photo hero with dates, venue and two buttons, then highlights, dates, speakers.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other conference site by design.
